propositions: The plan-review gate lacks a criterion to determine whether a proposed change is actually needed (necessity / no-op gap mirroring FixedBench's 35-65% over-action finding).
Bug tickets are gate-exempt and short-circuit to bare PASS with zero LLM review (verified on bug 5886: REVIEW_RESULT had exempt runner, zero llm_calls).
A new advisory pass-1 criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing need, accepting justified no-op / docs-only / well-motivated outcomes.
Bug tickets must receive a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe) instead of exempt-PASS, never blocking a bug via advisory posture + empty det_blocking.
Both pieces (necessity criterion and bug tier) ship advisory and auto-flow into standing effectiveness recorder (d8a5) with zero wiring for promotion to blocking post-dogfood monitoring.
